SHEET PAN SAUSAGE + VEG
4 servings
14 oz smoked turkey sausage sliced
2 sweet potatos diced
1 head broccoli in florets
2 Tbs olive oil
1 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp chili flakes
toss sweet potatos and broccoli in olive oil, garlic powder and chili flakes
roast at 425 for 15 min, add sausage, roast 15 more min
